violationSemantics.V1: test-only injection detection: for every registered service injection API (method), scan call sites (member-access form `.setX(` / `this.setX(` / cast-form `(Type)).setX(`; method declarations and javadoc do NOT count) across ALL nop-stream module src/main/java + src/test/java, receiver-qualified to AbstractStreamOperator + its main subclasses (declared receiver type / `this` / cast type must be an operator class - CheckpointConfig.setStateBackend / StreamExecutionEnvironment.setStateBackend declarations and their non-operator receivers do NOT match). disposition = production-wired: main call sites == 0 -> red (violation string carries service name + injection API + main/test call-site stats); main > 0 -> green regardless of test injection. disposition = internal-creation: main zero call sites are NOT red (carve-out, reason registered above, ratchet-constrained).
violationSemantics.V2: consumer enumeration completeness: call sites of the registered service getters `getProcessingTimeService()` / `getTimeServiceManager()` and of `registerTimerService(` in src/main/java (all nop-stream modules) must have their owning top-level class (file fqcn) in this registry's consumerTable; new consumer class -> red.
violationSemantics.V3: stale wiring point: a registry wiringPoint (file:line) must still exist in main code (file exists + line exists + line contains the injection method name); otherwise -> red (forces honest registry maintenance).
violationSemantics.V4: new injection API: `set*` method declarations in AbstractStreamOperator.java or its main subclasses whose single parameter type is a registered service param type (raw type in {Output, ProcessingTimeService, TimerServiceManager, IStateBackend, IKeyedStateBackend, IOperatorStateBackend, Consumer-with-genericArg-OperatorSnapshotResult}; setKeyContextElement1/2 (StreamRecord), setCurrentKey (Object), setMailboxExecutor (MailboxExecutor), setProgressMarker (Runnable) etc. do NOT trigger) and not in this registry's injectionApi set -> red.
violationSemantics.V5: stale consumer / stale service: a registry consumer class or registry service class no longer exists as a type in main code -> red.
violationSemantics.pinMatching: violations subset of mjs-pins.json pinnedViolations (p.key exact match against the scanner's violation string) = green; pins may only cover adjudicated watch-only residuals / known exemptions. Expected zero pins at I1: internal-creation is a registry disposition, NOT a pin. A pin whose violation no longer exists = stale-pin error.

pinSchema.key: required; the scanner's exact violation string (must match compareViolationsToPins p.key exact-match protocol)
pinSchema.removalTrigger: residual resolved or exemption lifted with human confirmation + trace; NO silent removal
